name: Abel
role: Keeper of flocks, killed by his brother
summary: The second son of Adam and Eve, a keeper of sheep. The LORD looked with favour on his offering of the firstborn of his flock, and his brother Cain, angry, killed him in the field. The LORD tells Cain that his brother's blood cries out from the ground. Jesus calls him righteous, and Hebrews holds up his faith.
body: Abel never speaks in Genesis. He brings fat portions from the firstborn of his flock, the LORD regards his offering, and his brother kills him. His name, hebel in Hebrew, is the word Ecclesiastes uses for breath, vapour, futility.

Jesus names him as the first of the righteous whose blood was shed, from Abel to Zechariah. Hebrews says that by faith he offered a better sacrifice than Cain, and that Jesus' blood speaks a better word than his.
